# Pinned installed-modifier acquisition sources

These JSON/Java files are unchanged from Tinkers' Construct revision
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2

Source paths and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in the manifest. Native goals
adapt only their icon item keys. Tool-stack and conjunction source fixtures
are retained in the sibling `modified_tool` and `slimeskull` directories.
